entities.summary: Clemente Jaime Yoshiyama Tanaka is a Peruvian Fujimorist politician. He was the President of the Democratic Constitutional Congress from December 1992 to July 1995. He was also the Minister of the Presidency during the administration of President Alberto Fujimori.
